# SNGDC Documentation

> Documentation for the SNGDC app — a web and mobile application for a synthetic
> natural gas (SNG) distribution company operating in Pakistan. The app combines a
> customer portal (accounts, billing, usage analytics, notifications, support) with
> an internal RBAC admin and content-management studio that powers the public company
> website. Built with React 19, Capacitor 8 (Android/iOS/web), Radix UI, and Firebase
> (Auth + Firestore + Hosting). Author/maintainer: Ahsan Mahmood (https://aoneahsan.com).

Honest scope: this documentation describes how the SNGDC application works for
customers and operators. It is not a synthetic-natural-gas engineering manual, and it
does not cover the physical gas distribution network. The app does not process in-app
payments. Live app: https://sndgc.aoneahsan.com

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/intro): What SNGDC is and what the app does.
- [Account & Sign-in](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/account-and-sign-in): Registration, Google sign-in, and roles.
- [Customer Dashboard](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/getting-started/customer-dashboard): The signed-in customer home.

## Customer features

- [Billing](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/features/billing): Viewing bills and statements.
- [Usage Analytics](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/features/usage-analytics): D3-powered consumption charts.
- [Notifications](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/features/notifications): In-app and push notifications.
- [Support](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/features/support): Raising and tracking support tickets.
- [Profile & Account](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/features/profile-and-account): Profile editing and account deletion.

## Admin & operations

- [Admin Overview](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/admin/overview): The operations back office.
- [RBAC & Users](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/admin/rbac-and-users): Roles, permissions, and user management.
- [Societies & Customers](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/admin/societies-and-customers): Managing societies and customer records.
- [Content Studio](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/admin/content-studio): Editing the public website content.
- [Billing, Advertising & Analytics](https://docs.sndgc.aoneahsan.com/admin/billing-advertising-analytics): Operational dashboards.
